thread:
jen: Hey team — we need one quick alignment on the Console Observability PRD before the exec review on Friday. Main asks: retention tiers, trace linking UX, and acceptance criteria for alerting. I sketched a minimal scope below, pls react with 👍 / request changes.
mike: 👍 can we keep retention tiers to 7/30/90 for GA and add a 365 day enterprise add-on? customers keep asking for 1y for audits.
sara: Agree on 7/30/90, but callout that 90-day will have summarized rollups to reduce index size. We should list what gets rolled up (metrics histograms only, traces are sampled).
jen: Good point. Proposal: full-resolution metrics for 7/30, 1:8 rollup beyond 30 up to 90, then 1:30 rollup to 365 (enterprise). Traces sampled: 1:1 for 7 days, 1:10 for 30, 1:100 beyond 30. Thoughts?
pranav: Sampling numbers look fine, but need to add acceptance criteria for trace linking: "Click from span -> log context" must surface within 200ms on average for GA. Also error states if log not found should show "context unavailable" rather than 500.
kevin: +1 on 200ms SLA. Also add fallback for missing KV cache: show cached breadcrumbs and async fetch — UX should not block the detail pane.
alyssa: For rollout gates, can we add customer-driven canary? i.e., 10% of orgs get full retentions + trace-linking for 2 weeks, check error rates and cost delta. If cost delta > 12% baseline then rollback auto. Add this to rollout policy.
jen: I like canary. Add explicit metrics to watch during canary: token cost / day, kv-cache hit rate, p95 link latency, trace ingest rate. Set automatic rollback threshold as alyssa said.
mike: One more acceptance item: console should expose per-route cost breakdown in the trace view header when available. That is a CX ask from platform teams.
sara: UX flow: clicking a trace should open a right-side panel with 1) flamechart 2) logs 3) cost breakdown 4) related alerts. Keep panel sticky for navigation. Add keyboard shortcut `t` to focus.
pranav: Edge cases to call out in PRD: a) trace references logs that live in external logging provider (we must show link with warning) b) multi-region traces where KV lookup may route cross-region — add network fallback plan.
jen: Good list. Draft acceptance checklist so we can include in PRD:
```
- Feature flags exist for retention tiers + trace-linking
- End-to-end trace -> log linking under test corpus within 200ms p95
- Sampling applied and verified across workloads (low/high qps)
- Canary rollout instrumentation: cost, latency, error rate dashboards
- UX panel works when logs missing (displays "context unavailable")
- Per-route cost header shows accurate token and compute breakdown
- RBAC: enterprise retention toggle visible only to org admins
```
kevin: Also add observability tests: synthetic trace with injected missing log ID, assert UI shows fallback, and a synthetic high-ingest day to validate rollup path.
alyssa: For prioritization: customer asks (AuditCo, FinX, HealthHub) requested 365 retention + trace linking. Recommend we do GA without 365 by default, but land enterprise 365 in Q2 as paid add-on. That keeps GA schedule.
mike: Timeline ask: if we cut scope to exclude 365 and exclude the enterprise RBAC UI, we can ship GA in 6 weeks. With 365 it pushes to 10-12 weeks.
jen: Ok decision: scope for GA = 7/30/90 retention, trace-linking with sampling and UI panel, per-route cost header, canary rollout. Enterprise 365 + RBAC + long-term rollups = follow-up epic targeting Q2. I'll update PRD and include acceptance checklist above.
pranav: Quick note: add automated tests for traced links that validate cross-region fallback (we had one flake last quarter that surfaced only under eu-west load).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — feature flag scaffold created: `obs_prd_trace_linking_v1` by infra. Use this flag for canary targeting.
jen: Great — I will push an updated PRD draft in the doc and tag for review. Please drop any final must-have items by EOD. :thumbsup:
